entry.title: ProstoCAD 0.17.5: Areas to click, sound solids, Text frames
entry.content:
Added

  • Extrude, Revolve and Emboss show a sketch's closed areas in their window: click the ones to use, ⌘A / Ctrl+A takes them all.
  • Extrude, Revolve, Shell, Patterns and Mirror are built directly on the geometry kernel: sound solids where they used to fail, exact volumes, sharp edges.
  • Shell ▸ No opening makes a closed hollow; Pattern ▸ Solid repeats a whole Solid.
  • Sketch ▸ Text: a Rectangle, Ellipse or Circle frame, drawn dashed in the sketch, and smooth letters.
  • Sketch tools work tool first: pick the tool, then click in the sketch.

Fixed

  • A section through a part of several touching Solids cuts each Solid in its own colour; it showed the cut hollow.
  • The model tree's right-click menu opens beside the tree, not over its rows.
  • An assembly whose part file is missing says so on opening and does not save without it.
  • Fillets, chamfers and shells keep their edges when the part changes size.
  • Quitting from outside (the Dock, logging out) no longer ends in a crash report.
